geometry_notes: E3 is two buildings in one footprint: the 1960s buff-brick lab complex (flat roofs 4-7 m, a 9.2 m central clerestory high bay, 11-13.5 m blocks at the SW corner) and a 4-storey 2010s addition at the north (14.4 m) with a newer 1-2 storey brick wing along the east road (W33-W36) and the E5 bridge tower (W31).

DC's spec puts an 'E3 entrance' in DC's footprint (DC W14-W16). Its W16 photo (sv_W16_Cv0C) is the same pano as E3's sv_c44_Cv0C, which shows E3's north entrance on E3 W0 s 31-37 (art ~(1107-1113, 347-350)), ~20 m north of DC W16. To avoid drawing the entrance twice, DC W16 should probably be plain brick / glass link, or hidden; E3 W0 carries the entrance (same doors/canopy/sign description as DC's).

DC's W13 is marked as a party wall with E3 W2, but the photos and lidar show a ~10 m asphalt service lane between DC's south lobe and E3 W2 (sv_W2_-SkkM, sv_c0). Both walls are visible and E3 W2 is specified.
W1 s 20-36 (9.7 m) and the 9.4 m mass between the addition and W2's 6 m strip are lidar-only; the 9.4 mass has no documented faces (its edges fall back to the nearest wall).
The lidar over W32 and W33 s 0-6 (14.4-15.2 m) is the E5 bridge and its tower, not the 1-storey brick wing (4.6 m) under it.
Lidar 12-15 m in the courtyard (W14, W15 s 12-22) and at W7 b is tree canopy (conifers, maple), not building.
W29 s 3.5-8.5 lidar 8 m, 5 m deep, is the post-2014 porte-cochere, not a roof.
Upper faces U0-U3 (central clerestory box), U4 (east wing second storey) and U5 (addition's SE face above the 9.4 m roof) are added from lidar blobs; positions +-1.5 m.

W0.summary: north face of the 4-storey 2010s E3 addition on the plaza shared with DC: buff brick with dark-framed glazing groups and charcoal fins; tall storefront ground floor on a precast/concrete base, three upper storeys of 3-pane window groups between brick bands, G2N Lab roll-up door, plain brick pier with TAXI STAND sign, then the glazed north entrance (two pairs of white-framed doors, silver flat canopy, curtain wall to the roof, black E3 sign) at the west (b) end

ground/entrance.note: two pairs of white-framed glass doors in a full-height storefront (glass also left of and above the doors up to the band); flat silver canopy at ~3.6 m across the whole bay

attached: entrance canopy (flat, silver metal, ~1.8 m deep, soffit downlights) over s 31.4-37
galvanised bike rack (5 hoops on a rail) at s 26-29.5, 0.8 m out
W0.notes: sv_W0_iZkC (s 5), sv_W0_pqZu (s 15), sv_W0_lW6E (s 26) and sv_c44_Cv0C (May 2025, entrance square-on); earth_W0_whole (2024) for the 3 upper storeys and the full-height curtain over the entrance. Ground glazing groups are 3 panes wide x 2 high (lower pane taller); upper groups 3 x 2 with a short top lite. Fins are charcoal metal strips between groups, stopping at each brick band. The base is ~0.95 m at the east end and drops to ~0.3 m at the door bay (grade rises westward). This entrance is the one the DC spec describes as its W16 (sv_W16_Cv0C is this same pano): it is on E3 W0 s 31-37, not inside DC's footprint (see geometry_notes). The entrance bay may project ~0.5 m from the wall plane (sv_W1 shows a short brick return) - not certain.
